integrity: Formal proof is provided, with two independent finite coefficient checks and no claim of external or independent validation. New theorem is an arithmetic partition congruence (primary MSC 11P83), not a statement about general enumerative partition identities.
scientific_limitations: No general congruence modulo 16 is asserted; the square-index uniform bound fails at n=36. Distinct mex definitions are not conflated; full inspection of several adjacent published articles was not achieved and priority remains vulnerable to unknown equivalent work.
title: Sharp modulo-eight classification for odd minimal excludants of overpartitions
